modern: No one can rob us of our free will.
original: No man can rob us of our free will.
notification: No one can rob us of our free will.
notification_original: No man can rob us of our free will.

explained.summary: No one can take away your power to choose how you respond. A thief can take your belongings, an illness your health, a rival your position, but the will that decides what you think and how you act stays yours. This is the core of Stoic freedom, borrowed from Epictetus.
